Messages.Author: Dave Brereton
Messages.Body:
> Hi =)

Hi

> i just want another confirmation about some votes.
> Can a meth call disputed territory even if there is no location in play ?

No, it must target a location.

> Can a meth call disputed territory if the only location is his, and he
wants
> to give control to himself for the purpose of playing voter cap ?
> -that is can you take control of something you already control ?
> If this is possible, what if you call disputed territory on your Blythe's
> Ankara Citadel, and gain control of it again -can you move it on any of
your
> minions ? (i guess not, since there was a parallel with the rack and
> disputed territory)

I think you can. You can target your hunting ground and give it to someone
else.....
Disputed Territory takes a location and gives ownership of that location to
a chosen player. According to card text there are no restrictions on
calling DT on your own location and setting the owner to yourself.

>
> when a meth call Rumors of Gehenna, can he choose himself only as the
target
> , since the text says "a set" ? May "a set" = one ?

Yes. Set can = 1.
